items.title: Ray Bauduc Interview, 1984-06-27
items.q: Sidney was playing, was playing cornette in the band, see.

ctx.x: And that was the band, Charlie Johnson's band. Yeah. And they had the, they weren't one of the greatest drummers there, uh, George Stafford. Mm-hmm. And his sister, his sister was singing in a chorus there, see. And he just, he just had a good, solid beat. Mm-hmm. All these other guys, they all want to be funny guys, and turn sticks around and be a fancy drummer. Yeah. And they're not the drums and stuff, what they're supposed to be playing. Mm-hmm.
